crossRefs.note: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this…
He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing…
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
“Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was…
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

translations.web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
translations.asv: But he said unto them, I must preach the good tidings of the kingdom of God to the other cities also: for therefore was I sent.
